boundary.message: The fog closes in. You turn back.

content.outro: The far jetty is under your feet. Whatever stands out there in the fog, you have seen it once.
content.premise: A ferry crosses a strait under fog and storm. Halfway over, lightning tears the fog open for a heartbeat, and something colossal is standing in the sea.
content.theme: A fogbound crossing under a thunderstorm, and a glimpse of a drowned god the size of a hill.
content.title: The Thing Beyond the Fog
